scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:web
scripts.build:web: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @countryballs/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && npm run typecheck -w @countryballs/cloudflare && npm run typecheck -w @countryballs/web
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run check:boundaries
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w @countryballs/cloudflare
scripts.deploy: npm run verify && npm run build:web && npm run deploy -w @countryballs/cloudflare
scripts.cf:check: npm run build:web && npm run check -w @countryballs/cloudflare
